retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast aesthetic featuring a black-and-white subject against a vibrant, flat neon background with bold, stacked condensed typography.
triggerTerms: neon green background with black and white portrait
high contrast indie album cover style
flat color background with harsh flash photography
stacked condensed sans-serif typography on vibrant color

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered black-and-white portrait of a man in a striped shirt and flat cap, rendered with high-contrast lighting and a hard drop shadow against a solid, vibrant lime-green background, framed by a thin black border and anchored by bold, left-aligned condensed text.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subject vs. vibrant flat-color background
Hard-edged drop shadow vs. flat background plane
Horizontal stripes on clothing vs. vertical orientation of typography
Tight framing within a square composition
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white subject treatment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered vertically, slightly offset to the right, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The high-contrast face and the bold typography in the top-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold text, move to the subject's face, follow the stripes down to the hands/object, and return to the background color.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant flat negative space on the right and bottom, balanced by text on the top-left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Lime Green (#C0FF00) as the flat background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure Black (#000000) for shadows, borders, and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure White (#FFFFFF) for secondary text and highlights on the subject.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation in the background vs. zero saturation in the subject.
paletteRestrictions: No mid-tone colors in the background

treatment.fill: black and white alternating by line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family using color to distinguish hierarchy between lines.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.
Clean, condensed, and modern for an indie aesthetic.
Offers various condensed widths with a vintage-modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man in a striped shirt and flat cap against a solid, flat neon-lime green background. Apply a hard black drop shadow to the man. Include a thin black border around the entire square frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add four lines of stacked, left-aligned, extra-condensed sans-serif text in the top-left corner. The first two lines should be black, and the bottom two lines should be white.

verificationChecks: Is the background a single flat neon color?
Is the subject strictly black and white?
Is the text extra-condensed and stacked?
Is there a hard drop shadow behind the subject?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific person's likeness
Do not use the specific brand name or album title
postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed between subject and background
Ensure text is legible against the neon background
Verify the square aspect ratio and black border
Confirm the shadow is hard-edged and not feathered
recipe.reuseFormula: High-Contrast Monochrome Subject + Flat Neon Background + Stacked Condensed Sans-Serif Typography
